OSwind third-party components

USearch 2.26.5 — vector search engine by Ash Vardanian and contributors
https://github.com/unum-cloud/USearch
Pinned revision: 7a4abfb2033935498256044e01bc0049ec80d76c
License: Apache License 2.0 (see Apache-2.0.txt)

NumKong 7.8.5 — SIMD math kernels by Ash Vardanian and contributors
https://github.com/ashvardanian/NumKong
Pinned revision: 337c1cb6e6fbea8c08b3b7b385e392ed95ccab46
License: Apache License 2.0 (see Apache-2.0.txt)

These components are resolved by Swift Package Manager. Original OSwind code
remains MIT licensed. Model weights have separate publisher licenses and are
not included in the repository or application bundle.

FluidAudio 0.17.7 — FluidInference and contributors
https://github.com/FluidInference/FluidAudio
Pinned revision: 503b4bd1bbf7220882de39fe8ae6716aae4132da
License: Apache License 2.0. Optional NeMo text normalization is disabled.
Includes FastCluster (BSD-2-Clause), VBx (Apache-2.0), and bundled optional
text frontend resources; original upstream notices are in FluidAudio/.
OSwind uses ASR only in this increment; speech weights are user-selected,
loaded locally and never redistributed in this app.

Parakeet v3 Core ML conversion: FluidInference; original model: NVIDIA
https://huggingface.co/FluidInference/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-coreml
https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3
Converted model card metadata says CC BY 4.0; its prose says Apache 2.0.
NVIDIA's base model expressly uses CC BY 4.0. Preserve NVIDIA/FluidInference
attribution and consult the actual converted weights' license.
No model download or weight redistribution is performed by recognition.

Optional imported-speaker weights (downloaded separately, never bundled):
pyannote Community-1, WeSpeaker, BUT Speech@FIT PLDA, and Fluid Inference
modified Core ML conversions. Scoped CC-BY-4.0 assets at model revision
 df2625ac79a7ac6b65ad868fee6d80f320da4232.
https://huggingface.co/FluidInference/speaker-diarization-coreml
The installer retains NOTICE.md, README.md citations, LICENSE, PROVENANCE.md
and provenance.json. Legacy lowercase online models are excluded. Reconstructed
provenance does not establish a fully attested reproducible conversion build.

Visual encoder foundation (optional weights are not bundled):
Google SigLIP2 base-patch16-224 — Apache-2.0 publisher model declaration
https://huggingface.co/google/siglip2-base-patch16-224
Original revision: 75de2d55ec2d0b4efc50b3e9ad70dba96a7b2fa2.
The local conversion recipe records all source and compiled-file hashes.
A locally authored checksum manifest is integrity evidence, not a Google signature.

Hugging Face swift-transformers 1.3.5 and transitive tokenizer dependencies:
See VisualRuntime/PINNED.txt and the original license files in VisualRuntime/.
The native runtime constructs the tokenizer from bounded local Config values. It does not fetch
models, use a Hugging Face credential, or send visual inputs to a service.

Pillow 11.3.0 resize coefficient convention — Pillow/HPND license.
https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/tree/11.3.0
See VisualRuntime/Pillow-LICENSE (also Pillow/LICENSE in the source tree).

Optional local visual-model preparation:
uv 0.13.5 — Astral Software Inc. and contributors (MIT OR Apache-2.0)
https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/tag/0.13.5
The app fetches the checksum-pinned official Apple Silicon executable separately;
it is not bundled. Its MIT license is packaged in VisualPreparation/ and retained
with the cached executable. Managed CPython 3.12.15 and the frozen Python package
environment are separate cache downloads with their own installed licenses.
See scripts/convert-visual-model.py.lock for exact dependency artifacts and hashes.
The local conversion scripts are OSwind source; downloaded Python dependencies
and model weights are not linked into or redistributed with the application.
